title: Non-flammable electrolytes for high-safety sodium-ion batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00236B, Review Article
Sicheng Miao, Ya You, Zhi Wang, Yanan Zhao, Honghong Fan, Xinping Ai, Yuliang Cao, Yongjin Fang
This review comprehensively summarizes the research progress on non-flammable electrolytes for high-safety sodium-ion batteries, while providing constructive suggestions for future electrolyte design.
